info.title: TLY Link Shortener Universal API
info.description: Create, manage, and analyze shortened links, tags, pixels, QR codes, OneLinks, and UTM presets in T.LY.

post.description: Creates short links in bulk in TLY Link Shortener.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

links[].description: List of destination URLs to shorten in bulk.

domain.description: Optional branded domain to use for every generated short link.

tags[].description: Optional tag IDs to attach to every generated short link.

pixels[].description: Optional pixel IDs to attach to every generated short link.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
